title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Pickup Policy: Late Pickups, Warnings and Dismissal
content:
**Late pickup.** Under the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program, a pickup is late when the student is signed out more than the grace period after the plan's after-school close time. Minutes late are counted from the close time itself, not from the end of the grace period. Each late pickup is recorded once per service date.

**First incident.** When the plan waives the first incident, the first late pickup of each semester is recorded as a waived first incident. *The former clause that every other late pickup is chargeable and posts a late pickup fee of the minutes late multiplied by the per-minute late pickup fee is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current late pickup fee basis.*

**Semesters and the count.** The fall semester runs August 1 through December 31 and the spring semester January 1 through June 30. The count of late pickups in a semester is the number of late pickups recorded on the enrollment for that semester, whatever their fee status, so waived incidents are included.

**Warning and dismissal.** When the count reaches the warning threshold, the program director issues one written warning for that semester. When it reaches the dismissal threshold, the student is dismissed after the fee for that pickup posts.

**Exclusions.** Late pickup fees are not discounted by rate basis or sibling position, and they are not covered by Workforce Solutions remittances. A plan with no after-school session has no late pickups under this policy.

## Figures by plan

| Plan | Grace period | Late pickup fee per minute | First late pickup of each semester waived | Warning at | Dismissal at |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The five plans with an after-school session (After-School 2 Days, After-School 3 Days, After-School 5 Days, Before & After-School 5 Days, Pre-K Wraparound 5 Days) | 5 minutes | 1.00 per minute | yes | 3 late pickups in a semester | 5 late pickups in a semester |
| Creek Kids Club Before-School Care (5 Days) | 5 minutes | 1.00 per minute | yes | 3 | 5 |

The Before-School Care (5 Days) plan has no after-school session, so it has no late pickups under this policy even though its figures are set.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical close time of 18:00)

| Signed out | Minutes past close | Late? | Minutes late recorded |
|---|---|---|---|
| 18:05 | 5 | no, not more than the grace period | none |
| 18:06 | 6 | yes | 6 |
| 18:19 | 19 | yes | 19 |

## Semester count (hypothetical)

In one fall semester a student has late pickups on three different dates. The first is recorded as a waived first incident. All three count, so the third reaches the warning threshold of 3 and one written warning is issued for that fall semester. A fifth late pickup in the same semester reaches the dismissal threshold, and the student is dismissed after that pickup's fee posts. Late pickups in January start the spring count from zero.

superseded_clauses: every other late pickup is chargeable and posts a late pickup fee of minutes_late times late_pickup_fee_per_minute.
